evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $40,000,000; attorneys' fees $8,000,000; clear sailing no
We propose an automatic distribution and fee terms that preserve the court’s independent review
Our offer preserves court review of fees and directs any unawarded fee back to Brightline.

summary: Plaintiff-side counsel raised fees in the opening term sheets, before any class relief was settled, and the parties negotiated fee treatment alongside class relief. The transcript does not show any explicit tradeoff between attorneys’ fees and class recovery, any plaintiff self-dealing, defense leveraging of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
